# URL Shortener API — Documentation
This document describes the REST API implemented by `UrlShortenerController`.
Base URL
- When running locally the server base is `http://localhost:8080` (port may vary when running tests or with random ports)
Endpoints
1) Shorten a URL
- HTTP - Method: POST - Path: /api/shorten - Content-Type: application/json - Request body: { "url": "https://example.com/path" }
- Responses - 201 Created - Body (application/json): ```json { "code": "a1B2c3", "shortUrl": "http://localhost:8080/a1B2c3", "originalUrl": "https://example.com/path" } ``` - 400 Bad Request - Returned when the request body is missing or the provided URL is invalid (non-HTTP/HTTPS, missing host, or malformed).
- Notes - The server validates the `url` field is not blank and has a valid http/https URI. - The returned `shortUrl` uses the current request context as the base.
- Example `curl` ```bash curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/shorten \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"url":"https://www.originenergy.com.au/electricity-gas/plans.html"}' ```
2) Redirect to original URL
- HTTP - Method: GET - Path: /{code} - Example: GET /a1B2c3
- Responses - 302 Found - Location: <original URL> - 404 Not Found - Returned when the provided code doesn't exist in the in-memory store.
- Example `curl` (do not follow redirects automatically) ```bash curl -I http://localhost:8080/a1B2c3 # Look for HTTP/1.1 302 Found and Location header ```
3) Get short code info
- HTTP - Method: GET - Path: /api/info/{code} - Example: GET /api/info/a1B2c3
- Responses - 200 OK - Body (application/json): ```json { "code": "a1B2c3", "originalUrl": "https://www.originenergy.com.au/electricity-gas/plans.html", "createdAt": "2025-11-01T12:00:00Z", "redirectCount": 3 } ``` - 404 Not Found - Returned when the provided code doesn't exist.
- Example `curl` ```bash curl -s http://localhost:8080/api/info/a1B2c3 | jq . ```
Constraints and behavior
- Storage: in-memory ConcurrentHashMap. Data will be lost when the process exits. - Short codes: 6-character Base62 (0-9a-zA-Z), generated using SecureRandom. Collisions are checked and retried. - Validation: incoming URL must be valid http/https and have a host. Invalid URLs return 400. - Error handling: 400 for invalid input, 404 for not found.
Local development
- Build & run with Maven: ```bash mvn -U clean package mvn spring-boot:run ```
- Run tests: ```bash mvn -U clean test ```
Notes and recommendations
- The `shortUrl` base uses the request's host and port. If you want a custom domain (e.g., `http://short.ly`), change the service to read a configured property and use that as the base instead. - For production use add persistence (database) and consider authentication/rate-limiting to prevent abuse.
